intent.proves: A demo persona signs in through the storefront and is served a page as that user.
intent.scope: one persona per declared login type

sources.ref: A 10.30.6 Swift 2 host with sample-data personas, 2026-11-14: POST /dwapi/users/authenticate with each of three sample-data personas answered 200 with a token; GET /dwapi/users/info with that token answered 200 and named the same user id and user name.
